result.title: Outcome-Balanced PPO and Policy-Induced Flow Rectification for Flow-Based VLA Policies
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables post-training of flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies by optimizing expected task return through environment interaction. However, this optimization raises two challenges: policy updates can alter the velocity-field geometry underlying the score approximation used for stochastic transitions, and sparse multi-task rollouts can yield uneven learning signals across tasks and advantage signs. We introduce an RL framework that combines Outcome-Balanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with policy-induced flow rectification. Outcome-Balanced PPO reweights positive advantages using task success-rate estimates and rescales positive and negative advantages while preserving their signs. Policy-induced rectification periodically fits a linear-bridge flow to ODE endpoint pairs generated by the current policy, refreshing the representation used in subsequent stochastic optimization. We evaluate the framework on simulated manipulation benchmarks and additionally study a component combination in a Real2Sim2Real task, examining task performance, optimization behavior, and flow consistency. The proposed framework improves success rates over the evaluated baselines across the simulated benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一个面向 flow-based VLA 策略的强化学习后训练框架，将按任务成功率重加权优势的 Outcome-Balanced PPO 与周期性用当前策略生成的 ODE 端点对重拟合线性桥 flow 的「策略诱导校正」结合，在仿真操作基准及一项 Real2Sim2Real 任务上考察性能、优化行为与 flow 一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 策略更新会使速度场几何与用于随机转移的 score 近似失配，因而需周期性重拟合生成表示，这一「生成器随策略漂移而重校准」线索可供核查是否适用于 latent 推理轨迹训练中的分布偏移与监督更新；但该文针对机器人动作生成，与视觉推理状态本身联系较远。
